manifest_and_load: Read the selected model entry from pi_deployment_package/weights/manifest.json.
Verify the recorded ONNX SHA-256, or both NCNN param/bin SHA-256 values, before loading.
Record manifest registration separately from successful target-device load.
output_validation: Require exactly class_id, class_name, confidence, and bbox_xyxy fields.
Require integer class_id in [0, 24], class_name string matching the class map, and finite confidence in [0, 1].
Require four finite bbox coordinates in source-frame pixel space, with 0 <= x1 < x2 <= frame_width and 0 <= y1 < y2 <= frame_height.
Count invalid detections and frames; fail the integration check on any NaN/Inf or malformed/out-of-bounds box.
integration_guidance.tracking: No Python tracker implementation is present in blind-navigation/2_edge_device/modules/tracking in this checkout. Define the tracker input contract and verify handoff before marking tracking passed.
integration_guidance.soak: Run each model continuously for at least 30 minutes on a representative labeled stream. Count crashes, frame errors, and empty detections on frames expected to contain objects; sample temperature and vcgencmd get_throttled throughout the run.
integration_guidance.empty_detection_interpretation: An empty result is not inherently an error. Classify as anomalous only on labeled/known-positive frames or according to an agreed operational rule.
integration_guidance.stable_criteria: Mark stable only after the full 30-minute run completes with no crash, no unexplained frame errors, valid output and tracker handoff throughout, and acceptable thermal/power behavior.

source_notes.runtime_benchmark_metric: FPS equivalent is 1000 / p50_ms; it is not measured end-to-end video FPS.
source_notes.historical_throttle: Existing benchmark artifacts show no throttle/undervoltage at their sampled start/end boundaries; this is not a continuous-soak result.
source_notes.tracking_source_scan: blind-navigation/2_edge_device/modules/tracking contains no Python implementation in the current workspace.
source_notes.schema_mismatch_note: The best-model inference template emits bbox_xyxy; legacy deployment_config.yaml documents bbox. Align this contract when integrating with the tracker.
